Initial release of auto-updater skill.

- Adds daily automated updates for Clawdbot core and all installed skills via configurable cron job.
- Sends a summary message after each update run, listing what was updated and any issues.
- Provides quick setup instructions and advanced manual configuration options.
- Includes troubleshooting steps and guidance for enabling, disabling, or customizing auto-updates.
